verdict.rationale: NetHunt's pricing page documents filtering, grouping and sorting data, saving views and sharing them with the team. The homepage says users can modify fields and views to fit their processes, which covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating new custom field types, evidence that non-admin ops users can do this without admin involvement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can add custom fields and build filtered, sorted, and shared views without an admin project

citations.quote: Filter, group, and sort data the way you need it. Save views for quick access and share them with your team.
Modify fields, pipeline stages, views, and automations to match your unique processes.
